name: consent
title: Consent
description: Asks a fan before anything records them. A panel with Reject all and Accept all at the same size and weight, and Choose, which lists the categories as toggles; `expanded` opens straight onto the list for a Privacy settings link. The categories are the Monterosa SDK's: `necessary` is always on and never offered, and `analytics`, `marketing` and `functional` are. Headless of storage: it takes the fan's current choices as `value` and hands every category back as a plain yes or no through `onDecide`. It carries `data-gs-component="consent"` with `accept` and `reject` parts, which is what `gamestage verify` and `deploy` look for.
docs: On Gamestage, start the game with `consentBanner: false` so the client does not draw its own banner, then render `<Consent value={game.consent.record()?.categories} onDecide={(c) => game.consent.decide(c)} />` while `game.consent.needed()` is true and `game.consent.hostDecides()` is false. For a Privacy settings link, render it with `expanded`. Take the words from Studio (`consent_title`, `consent_accept_label` and the rest) and pass them as `strings`.
